en: An illustrated postcard depicting a triumphant procession of Julius Caesar in ancient Rome. Caesar, dressed in a red toga and gold armor, rides a chariot pulled by white horses through a cheering crowd. The background prominently features classical Roman architecture, including a large temple with columns, a monumental column topped with a statue, and other ancient buildings. Several people in Roman attire observe the procession, and Roman soldiers are present. The postcard contains French text and a signature.
